scripts.dev: node init && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @bingchun/db --ignore-scripts && concurrently -n backend,frontend,delivery,delivery-fe,stickers -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:delivery-frontend" "npm run dev:cup-stickers"
scripts.dev:web: node init && concurrently -n backend,frontend,stickers -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:cup-stickers"
scripts.dev:all: node init && concurrently -n backend,frontend,delivery,orders,payments,notify,stickers -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,red,white "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:orders" "npm run dev:payments" "npm run dev:notify" "npm run dev:cup-stickers"
scripts.dev:delivery: node init && cross-env DELIVERY_LOAD_BACKEND_ENV=true DELIVERY_PORT=4100 npm run dev -w @bingchun/delivery-service
scripts.build:cashier-desktop: node init && npm --prefix tools/cashier-desktop run dist
scripts.dev:driver-android: node init && cd driver_android && gradlew.bat installDebug
scripts.build:mobile: node init && cd mobile && ..\scripts\flutter.cmd build apk
scripts.build:driver-android: node init && cd driver_android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:customer: node init && cd customer_mobile && ..\scripts\flutter.cmd build apk --release --target-platform android-arm64 --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/app/outputs/symbols --dart-define=API_BASE=https://bing-chung-b.mp.dartcodes.com
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd mobile && ..\scripts\flutter.cmd pub get && cd ..\customer_mobile && ..\scripts\flutter.cmd pub get
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @bingchun/backend && npm run test -w @bingchun/frontend && npm run test -w @bingchun/delivery-service
